notes.title: Bug Fixes, Visual Improvements, and Optimizations!
notes.content:
[b]Cloakers,[/b]

Finally managed to squeeze in this update before the weekend! it consists of bug fixes, visual improvements, and optimizations, all based on your feedback over the past few days since free 2 play transition. 

[list]
[*] Fixed the freeze spell infinite money glitch when landing killing blow on an enemy. Freeze spell can no longer be spammed as it was unhealthy for the game. A minimum cooldown of 4 seconds has been added on top of the shots needed to recharge this spell. The cost has also been increased to 1700.
[*] Fixed a bug where some players were getting stuck underneath the boss room for the 2nd boss-fight.
[*] Improved and enabled smoother interactions with the Elder shop.
[*] Pixel art for the 4th boss has been improved. The skulls from his land piece attacks are now outlined in red to make them more visible and easier to dodge (used to blend with the bckground).
[*] Enemy positions at the start of the 2nd level have been readjusted to provide more room early on.
[*] The game timer should now display correctly at the end of the level.
[*] Minor tweaks to the UI
[*] Added the Elder shop to the Boss Rush mode, which was previously missing due to a spawning issue.
[/list]

That's it for now. Currently working on more UI improvements and enhancements to the end level.

As always, I will be on the lookout for your feedback on Discord and will continue to adjust and update the game accordingly. Please feel free to join as we build an active community!

[url=https://discord.gg/9czSKcGxvv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40577186/11fc06725da0c754799a8fe4b5e065dff3db445f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Cloaks and Capes is now FREE to Play With Major Updates!
notes.content:
[h1]Cloakers,[/h1]

[h3]Super excited to announce that the Game is in its best ever shape to date and is now free-to-play with tons of updates![/h3]

For the past two years, Cloaks and Capes has been a paid game, and I sincerely appreciate the support from everyone who has purchased and played it. After careful consideration, I’ve decided to make it free-to-play to expand our player base and reach as many people as possible with these many updates. I believe this will make C&C more enjoyable and accessible than ever before, with:

[b][list]
[*] Level Reworks, 
[*] New Enemies, 
[*] Corruption Blocks (new in-game elements), 
[*] Bug Fixes,
[*] Overall Refinements to every aspect of the game, and more!
[/list][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40577186/3968ac44bbb8b101d5932fbbbba6916e99cb3469.gif[/img]


As always, I will be on the lookout for your feedback on Discord and will continue to adjust and update the game accordingly. Please feel free to join as we build an active community!

[url=https://discord.gg/9czSKcGxvv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40577186/11fc06725da0c754799a8fe4b5e065dff3db445f.png[/img][/url]

Thanks again, and happy gaming! 🔥

[b]With best regards,
~Sole Developer of Cloaks and Capes
[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo
notes.content:
[b][h2]Gameplay Updates[/h2]
[/b]
[olist]
[*]Orange outline is now an indicator of dash ability being up
[*]Game's intro is 10 times better with more cinematic effects
[*]Dash speed is slower but has longer duration to match cloakers speed for smoother movement
[*]The mini boss mage has increased scale and is now bigger and easier to hit with cooler sound effects
[*]Ero, The enlightened boss has significantly less hp and spawns less blue ghosts to lower his difficulty
[*]Blue ghost has less hp and lower slow effect when attacking
[*]Great threat spawns easier monsters
[*]Better looking particle effect on death screen
[*]Upper floating platform is easier to land onto now
[*]Monsters turn grey when they die to distinguish from other alive monsters
[/olist]

[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b]

[olist]
[*]Fixed blur lasting for almost 14 seconds in the beginning
[*]You can now skip the elder using 'space' along with 'enter' as proposed by many except for the "Here is your son's spirit" line
[*]Fixed a bug where you could dash past the elder and ignore him completely
[*]Fixed playtime not displaying properly
[*]Fixed a certain spot in the beginning where you are safe from the storm that the storm doesn't touch
[*]Fixed a bug when being hit by an arrow in Walk of shame
[*]Powerups section in options has better visuals
[/olist]

Thanks for playing, Your feedback was much appreciated, Enjoy!
